sources.citation: T. Moroder et al., Permutationally invariant state reconstruction, arXiv:1205.4941 (2012)
sources.technical_content: Schur-Weyl decomposition and exact form of every PI state: arbitrary density operator on each spin irrep tensored with identity on the multiplicity space; multiplicity dimension formula.
sources.relation: Matches state parameterization and white sector weights after selecting p_j=(2j+1)m_j/2^N; provides no reduced-marginal bound.
sources.read_depth: Full technical proposition and surrounding decomposition; not proof-reconstructed for target.

sources.citation: M. Christandl, R. König, G. Mitchison, R. Renner, One-and-a-half quantum de Finetti theorems, arXiv:quant-ph/0602130 (2007)
sources.locator: Corollary II.3 lines 154-168; Theorem II.7 lines 181-210; Theorem II.10 lines 229-258
sources.technical_content: Finite trace-distance approximations of symmetric-subspace and arbitrary permutation-invariant marginals by mixtures of iid states; paper defines its trace-distance convention at lines 84-88.
sources.relation: The approximating iid mixture is unconstrained and does not force proximity to maximally mixed marginals from exact sector weights.
sources.read_depth: Full theorem statements and surrounding assumptions; target proof not reconstructed.

sources.citation: X. Ye, B. Bergh, N. Datta, Quantum de Finetti theorems for states and channels in any distance measure, arXiv:2609.40343 (2026)
sources.locator: Theorem 1 lines 131-144; standard trace-distance form lines 227-230
sources.technical_content: Operator-order finite de Finetti statement with an explicit defect parameter for arbitrary PI states, and trace-distance corollaries.
sources.relation: Strong unconstrained de Finetti approximation, but no restriction on the representing measure that encodes the exact white Schur weights.
sources.read_depth: Full theorem and stated trace-distance corollary; target proof not reconstructed.

sources.citation: S. Singh, N. J. Cerf, Symmetry-driven thermalization via finite de Finetti theorems, arXiv:2604.09410 (2026)
sources.locator: Definitions/shell structure lines 52-72; Theorem 1 lines 99-127; Appendix D Lemma 3 and Theorem 2 lines 486-510
sources.technical_content: Trace-distance approximation to thermal product mixtures and relative-entropy bound under energy-preserving-unitary invariance, which makes each energy shell maximally mixed.
sources.relation: Closest relative-entropy analogue found, but stronger/different invariance and a different comparator; fixed-k regime differs from target r<=N/128.
sources.read_depth: Full assumptions and theorem statements; target proof not reconstructed.

sources.citation: Y. Li, G. Smith, Quantum de Finetti theorem under fully-one-way adaptive measurements, arXiv:1408.6829 (2014)
sources.technical_content: Finite de Finetti approximation measured in the fully-one-way LOCC distinguishability norm.
sources.relation: Measurement norm and unconstrained iid mixture differ from target local quantum marginal chi-square.
sources.read_depth: Full theorem statement and norm definitions.

sources.citation: R. Koenig, R. Renner, A de Finetti Representation for Finite Symmetric Quantum States, arXiv:quant-ph/0410229 (2005)
sources.technical_content: Finite symmetric-state representation conditioned on informationally complete measurement outcomes and empirical types.
sources.relation: Measurement-conditioned representation, not unconditional chi-square closeness to white.
sources.read_depth: Technical theorem region inspected; no complete independent reconstruction.

sources.citation: M. Kossmann, J. Zeiss, Fixed points in de Finetti hierarchies, arXiv:2607.23689 (2026)
sources.technical_content: One-sided permutation-invariant extension with fixed-point-channel constraints, approximated by separable/fixed-point product structure.
sources.relation: Different bipartite interface and constraint; does not impose the target's exact spin-sector probabilities.

sources.citation: T. Eggeling, R. F. Werner, Hiding classical data in multi-partite quantum states, arXiv:quant-ph/0203004 (2002)
sources.locator: Model/invariance setup lines 51-78; security examples lines 89-120
sources.technical_content: Multipartite Werner/permutation-invariant data-hiding states and security under specified local communication patterns.
sources.relation: Different local dimension, party partition, and communication model; not an N-qubit r-subsystem-per-preparation theorem.
sources.read_depth: Model and technical construction spans inspected.

sources.citation: V. Popkov, M. Salerno, Reduced density matrix and entanglement entropy of permutationally invariant quantum many-body systems, arXiv:1112.6352 (2012)
sources.locator: Model scope lines 48-76; reduced density matrix formulas lines 90-145
sources.technical_content: Exact reduced states for fixed-magnetization eigenspace/projector families in a complete-graph spin model.
sources.relation: Specific model/family rather than arbitrary spin-irrep density operators at white sector weights.

sources.citation: T. Gao, F. Yan, S. J. van Enk, On the permutationally invariant part of a density matrix and nonseparability of N-qubit states, arXiv:1401.4495 (2014)
sources.locator: Equations (18)-(19), HTML lines 137-147; general PI setup lines 77-80
sources.technical_content: PI noisy-W family approaching the global maximally mixed state while remaining genuinely multipartite entangled for suitable parameters.
sources.relation: Does not meet exact white Schur-sector weights and does not address the requested local marginal bound; adjacent warning only.
